The '''Strehkforce''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They had a [[Strehkforce Camp|camp]] in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:GtSBBftM" />

==History==
{{Quote|A group of mercenaries from the area, Strehkforce mercenaries. They're commanded by Evan Strehk and Maris Fahrs. Robbery isn't usually their thing, but for some reason they wanted that beacon.|Vance Groten, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtSBBftM" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Strehkforce mercenaries went to [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] and stole a [[Stonewall Labs]] [[security beacon]] from [[Vance Groten]]. Spacers who were working with Groten later went to the mercenary camp, in the mountains, to recover it. The spacers attacked the Strehkforce mercenaries and killed their leaders [[Evan Strehk]] and [[Maris Fahrs]].<ref name="SWG:GtSBBftM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Strehkforce appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GtSBBftM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Strehkforce was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
